Such Host denial is NOT evidence that no decryption occurred; original credential/provider and retained plaintext ownership/disposal rules continue.
request_and_authority.grant: Only explicit true authorizes this capture and operation. false/throw/unknown internal errors preserve capability/source rejection and no credential/secret provider call. Input signature policy pins source verification only; output seed is obtained independently after grant/source validation, never inferred from pin or source bundle public key.

request_and_authority.input_signature_policy_binding: For withProtectedSectionSourceNode, request.signature_policy is the exact policy declared in the capture intent; options.signaturePolicy retains its original ProtectedAdmissionOptions meaning and must be closed, strictly copied and all-value equal to that declaration. If unequal or malformed, return SourceRouteFailure06 with SOURCE_INPUT_INVALID at input, none disclosure/body0, before capture, authority callback, any credential-value evaluation or provider calls. Read only options.signaturePolicy as an own data property; do not invoke accessors or evaluate credential while comparing. Input source pin/requireSignature never authorizes or selects output signing seed.

timeout.scope: request.timeout_ms applies to all four new operations. It is a per-invocation wall-clock deadline, not provider time, Host current_ms, a content timestamp, performance target, or a persisted cross-call capability. Original05 APIs are unchanged.
timeout.start: After confirming the native request/authority and closed nonsecret call arguments, at the entry to that API invocation before capture or any await, capture started_at=Date.now() once and deadline=started_at+request.timeout_ms. Reusing a valid request in a distinct permitted call starts a new invocation deadline, not a renewed protected source context.
timeout.boundary: Keep the original source comparison Date.now() > deadline. Check before further work and immediately after each awaited capture/grant/provider/Host operation, before obtaining/copying credential or output secret values, and before returning source/output bytes. No abort or extra promise is invented; a late callback may finish but its result cannot authorize subsequent work.
timeout.failure: Return the existing SourceRouteFailure06 SOURCE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. During capture/admission use stage admission; after authority grant use authorization; after an output-secret provider in production/revision use semantic; before final source/output return use return. Do not continue materialization/encryption/revision/output publication on a known expired invocation. Dispose retained native operations and release/wipe private owned plaintext/output secret/output buffers under original cleanup rules; never mutate caller-owned bytes.
timeout.late_provider: If outputSecretProvider resolves after deadline, do not read returned secret property values or invoke getters and do not produce output. Already observed source Host plaintext or an already confirmed/unknown transport effect remains truthfully recorded. No body-free failure erases earlier disclosure.
timeout.protected_relation: withProtectedSectionSourceNode additionally retains the same originating source deadline throughout its Host/revision/commit owner scope, originalExpiresAt and source Host nonrollback checks. A later context call cannot reset the originating deadline. The 8MiB/20MiB bounds remain protected-source-only; the 1..60000 timeout range applies to all new SourceOperationRequest06 calls.

Authored fields are not silently dropped; transport-controlled derived fields are rederived and disclosed in member_actions. Current C claims are refreshed only with original optional-presence rules. Signed outputs must satisfy the original signature policy; do not silently strip or forge a signature when changed content invalidates it.
